name: campus-bridge
description: Campus Bridge - placement and internship tracker with GDG Edge analytics (PERN monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run check -w client
